cls: Antiviral - oral prodrug of penciclovir (deoxynucleoside analogue DNA polymerase inhibitor)
quick: Herpes zoster: 500 mg every 8 hours for 7 days
May be taken with or without food
Pharmacovigilance data have not identified a drug-associated risk; use if needed
No human milk data; present in rat milk - weigh benefit vs risk
Dose adjustment required by creatinine clearance
No dosage adjustment specified; well-compensated hepatic impairment does not require adjustment
Renal function in renal impairment / high-risk patients
summary: Famciclovir is an oral prodrug that is rapidly converted to the active antiviral penciclovir, a deoxynucleoside analogue that inhibits herpes viral DNA polymerase. It is indicated in immunocompetent adults for recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores), recurrent genital herpes (treatment and suppression), and herpes zoster (shingles), and in HIV-infected adults for recurrent orolabial or genital herpes. Dosing varies by indication and requires adjustment in renal impairment. The most common adverse effects are headache and nausea.
indications: Treatment of recurrent herpes labialis (cold sores) in immunocompetent adults
Treatment of recurrent episodes of genital herpes in immunocompetent adults
Chronic suppressive therapy of recurrent genital herpes in immunocompetent adults
Treatment of herpes zoster (shingles) in immunocompetent adults
Treatment of recurrent orolabial or genital herpes in HIV-infected adults

dosage.n: For 7 days; start as soon as zoster is diagnosed (efficacy not established if begun >72 h after rash onset)
For 1 day; start at first sign/symptom (efficacy not established if begun >6 h after onset)
Start at first sign/symptom (tingling, itching, burning, pain, or lesion); do not exceed 1 dose
For 7 days; start at first sign/symptom (efficacy not established if begun >48 h after onset)

dosage.d: 500 mg q12h / 500 mg q24h / 250 mg q24h
dosage.n: Hemodialysis: 250 mg after each dialysis session

dosage.d: 500 mg q12h x1 day / 500 mg single dose / 250 mg single dose
dosage.n: Hemodialysis: 250 mg single dose following dialysis
Hemodialysis: 250 mg single dose following dialysis

admin: May be taken with or without food
Begin therapy at the earliest sign or symptom (prodrome) for best efficacy
Adjust dose based on creatinine clearance in renal impairment
Complete the prescribed course (except cold sore regimen, which is a single dose)
moa: Famciclovir is an orally administered prodrug of penciclovir. After absorption it is rapidly deacetylated and oxidized to penciclovir, an anti-alpha-herpesvirus deoxynucleoside analogue. In herpes-infected cells, viral thymidine kinase phosphorylates penciclovir to its monophosphate, which is converted by cellular kinases to penciclovir triphosphate. This inhibits viral DNA polymerase, blocking viral DNA synthesis.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity to famciclovir, its components, or to penciclovir (Denavir cream)
relative: Renal impairment (requires dose adjustment - risk of acute renal failure if overdosed)
Galactose intolerance, severe lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption (tablets contain lactose)
monitor: Renal function in patients with renal impairment
Penciclovir toxicity when co-administered with probenecid

preg: Available pharmacovigilance data with famciclovir in pregnant women have not identified a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse maternal/fetal outcomes. Animal studies showed no adverse developmental effects at exposures slightly above the maximum recommended human dose. Untreated HSV in pregnancy carries fetal/neonatal risks; use if benefit justifies risk.
lact: There are no data on the presence of famciclovir or penciclovir in human milk or effects on the breastfed infant. Penciclovir is present in the milk of lactating rats at concentrations up to ~8 times maternal plasma. Weigh the benefits of breastfeeding against the mother's clinical need and potential infant risk.
renal: Penciclovir is eliminated predominantly unchanged by the kidney, so famciclovir dosage must be adjusted by creatinine clearance for each indication (see dosing). Inappropriately high doses for the level of renal function have caused acute renal failure. Penciclovir is removed by hemodialysis - dose after dialysis sessions.
hepatic: No dosage adjustment is required in patients with well-compensated chronic hepatic impairment. Cytochrome P450 does not play an important role in famciclovir metabolism. Postmarketing reports include abnormal liver function tests and cholestatic jaundice.

moderate: Probenecid or other drugs significantly eliminated by active renal tubular secretion (may increase penciclovir plasma concentrations - monitor for penciclovir toxicity)
Raloxifene (potent aldehyde oxidase inhibitor in vitro - could decrease penciclovir formation; clinical magnitude not established)
minor: Drugs metabolized by or inhibiting aldehyde oxidase (potential interaction in penciclovir formation)
interactions.food: No clinically significant food interaction; may be taken with or without food
interactions.diagnostics: Postmarketing reports of abnormal liver function tests and thrombocytopenia

serious: Acute renal failure (with inappropriately high doses in renal impairment)
Cholestatic jaundice / abnormal liver function tests

monitoring: Renal function (creatinine clearance) before and during therapy in renal impairment and the elderly
Signs of penciclovir toxicity when used with probenecid
Neurologic symptoms (dizziness, somnolence, confusion) - advise caution with driving/machinery
counsel: Start treatment at the earliest sign or symptom of a recurrence (tingling, itching, burning, pain, or lesion)
For cold sores, take only the single prescribed dose - do not take more
Famciclovir is not a cure for cold sores or genital herpes
Genital herpes can be transmitted even without symptoms; use safer sex practices and avoid contact with lesions
May be taken with or without food
If you experience dizziness, drowsiness, or confusion, avoid driving or operating machinery
Tablets contain lactose - tell your provider if you have galactose intolerance or lactase deficiency
pk: Rapid and extensive conversion to active penciclovir after oral absorption
Penciclovir plasma peak (tmax) about 0.9 hour after a famciclovir dose
Penciclovir terminal half-life approximately 2-3 hours (prolonged in renal impairment)
Allows convenient indication-specific dosing (single dose to every 8 hours); no accumulation with multiple dosing
Store at 20-25 C (68-77 F); USP controlled room temperature
pearls: High oral bioavailability of penciclovir (~77%) allows less frequent dosing than oral acyclovir
Cold sore therapy is a single 1500 mg dose taken at the first prodrome
Renal dose adjustment is essential; inappropriately high doses have caused acute renal failure
CYP450 is not important in metabolism, limiting CYP-based drug interactions; penciclovir is removed by hemodialysis
missed: Take the missed dose as soon as you remember, then continue your regular schedule. If it is nearly time for your next dose, skip the missed one - do not double up. (For single-dose cold sore therapy, do not take an additional dose.)
overdose: Provide appropriate symptomatic and supportive care. Penciclovir is removed by hemodialysis, which may be used in significant overdose, particularly with reduced renal function. Acute renal failure has occurred with excessive dosing relative to renal function.
